title: SP Mobile v3
line: A redesign of the Singapore Polytechnic mobile app.
problem: This was a project done with my group for my User Experience Fundamentals (UXF) module. The Singapore Polytechnic app had received a lot of negative feedback about its user experience.
did: We redesigned the app so that it has a modern and minimalist look, without compromising any of its key features such as attendance taking.
outcome: A complete interactive prototype designed in Figma.
